description: Мы — команда, заинтересованная в создании практичных и инновационных решений на основе реальных данных NASA. В NASA Space Apps Challenge мы хотим не просто собрать очередной прототип, а разобраться в существующей проблеме, предложить собственный подход и проверить его на практике.Для нас главное — техническая сторона, экспериментирование и возможность создать что-то действительно новое и полезное.
summary:
Lunar Landing Site Navigator is a project designed to support the identification and evaluation of potentially safe landing locations on the Moon.

We developed a concept for a decision-support tool that allows users to explore and compare different lunar surface regions. The evaluation considers important factors such as elevation, surface slopes, terrain features, craters, illumination levels, and solar energy availability.

Our project addresses the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser challenge by helping users better understand lunar surface conditions and potential landing hazards.

This project is important because selecting a suitable landing site can improve spacecraft safety, reduce mission risks, and support future lunar exploration. Our goal is to contribute to safer and more informed decisions for upcoming lunar missions.
details:
Lunar Landing Site Navigator is a project developed to identify, analyze, and compare potentially safe landing locations on the Moon.

Our project helps users explore different lunar surface regions and evaluate their suitability for future space missions. Our team considered six key factors: elevation, surface slope, terrain roughness, craters, lunar dust risks, and solar illumination and energy availability.

The creative aspect of our project is its combined approach to lunar landing site evaluation. Instead of focusing only on landing safety, we also consider environmental conditions that may affect future operations on the Moon, including solar energy availability. This allows us to look at both immediate landing conditions and the potential for further exploration.

To develop our project, we used Python and JavaScript programming languages, along with HTML and CSS for web interface development.

The main benefit of our solution is its comprehensive approach to evaluating lunar landing sites. Instead of focusing only on landing safety, we also consider environmental conditions that may be important for future operations on the lunar surface.

The creative aspect of our project lies in combining multiple environmental and safety factors into one evaluation approach. Our intended impact is to support more informed landing site selection, reduce potential mission risks, and contribute to the development of future lunar exploration.
